description: This is a Java class for an Android Fragment that displays a list of receipts. It fetches receipt data from a remote API using Volley and displays it in a RecyclerView. If no receipts are found, it shows a message indicating that no receipts were uploaded today.

classes.name: ReceiptsList
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages and displays a list of receipts fetched from a remote server.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ReceiptsList fragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, sets up the RecyclerView, and initiates data loading.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Fetches receipt data from the server using Volley, updates the receipt list, and sets the adapter.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Replaces RecyclerView with a TextView message when no data is available.
